evidence:
DESIGN (source reading, no defect found). tests/scoring.toml: gates render=0.0, constraints=0.0; weights functional 0.6 / polish 0.2 / visual 0.2; floor functional 0.05 (identical to the frozen template, as is tools/score.py). The scored suites use aggregation = "weighted_mean": functional has 43 binary criteria (17 at weight 1.0, 20 at 1.5, 6 at 2.0; total weight 59), polish 6 binary, visual 3 likert with points = 5 and anchors 0-5. So reward is a many-step graded value, not binary. The criteria do not hang on one precondition. I grouped the 43 functional criteria by what they need: (a) editor only, no Run and no Save: 19 criteria, weight 23.5 (typing/join, caret navigation, grapheme, mouse selection, selection replace, block indent, caret in view, long line, three multi-caret, undo caret, find, replace current, replace all, self-containing replace, JS and HTML colouring, format-error); (b) need Run: 16 criteria, weight 23.5 (the two format-semantics criteria plus the 14 from cw_basic_run_output to cw_dynamic_code_refused); (c) need Save/server state: 8 criteria, weight 12.0. Undo is needed by about 12 criteria with weight 18.5 (31%), multi-caret by 3 with weight 5.5; cw_same_line_carets and cw_multi_caret_delete explicitly decouple ('Undo behaviour is not judged here', 'whether both modifiers work is scored elsewhere, not here'), and many runtime criteria carry 'scored elsewhere, not here' splits (cw_basic_run_output, cw_last_good_recovery, cw_time_limit_recovery, cw_stop_cancels_pending_work). Polish is decoupled from Run correctness (cw_controls_feedback_and_labels: 'whatever the outcome of that Run'; cw_narrow_width_usable: 'Whether Run produces the right output is scored elsewhere, not here'). The gates are minimal: render gate is one criterion that only loads, types one word and reloads ('Do not press Run, do not save anything and do not judge any other feature here'); constraints gate is the own-surface check and one save-clear-storage-reopen check. Worked spread under score.py: an app with a working editor and persistence but a broken Run would get functional 35.5/59 = 0.602 -> 0.361 plus polish and visual; an app with no Undo loses 18.5/59 of functional; an app without multi-caret loses 5.5/59; each stays above the 0.05 floor. Broken-app attempt: a static shell fails the render gate (typed word must appear); a textarea editor fails the constraints gate; an app that only looks good gets functional near 0 and is zeroed by the floor. Conforming-alternative attempt: I found no conforming partial app whose whole score collapses through a shared precondition other than the two gates.

RUN EVIDENCE (why this is not a Pass). No app of partial quality has been scored on these bytes; the raw-evidence index itself says 'No configured judge run exists for these bytes' and 'No target-model score exists with the scored suites run.' The scripted golden results (runtime.json, editor.json, polish.json: every criterion true) show only the top of the scale. The hosted results on the EARLIER candidate are three points: Oracle 0.9833 (reward.json: functional 1.0, polish 1.0, visual 0.9167), nop 0, and the target model 0. That target-model 0 was a binary collapse, not a graded score: gates/reward-details.json shows constraints 1.0 with typing and Save both working, and render 0.0 on the old criterion cw_authored_custom_editor_run because 'Run is deterministically broken', so the scored suites never ran. The current render gate (cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing) no longer presses Run and cw_basic_run_output is now a weight-1.0 functional criterion, which by design would let that same app through the gates and into the 0.36+ band; that repair is not measured. qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md ('Runtime and model evidence') requires a separate hash-bound runtime record for reward discrimination, and the run directory holds none (checklist.json, manifest.json, per-row-review, preflight.json, raw-evidence-index.json only). Per the skill, an unmeasured claim is not upgraded to Pass, so the row stays Not exercised with risk=true.

NOTES (not failures). 1. cw_shared_saved_record in the constraints gate makes one working Save plus reopen after storage clear a precondition for any reward: an app with a complete editor and runner (47/59 of functional weight) but a broken save path scores 0. This is the template's gate mechanism applied to a stated hard requirement (integration.md: 'Use SQLite for persistent records', 'The library must be shared between independent browser contexts'), so I do not call it a defect, but it is the largest all-or-nothing step left in the reward. 2. All functional and polish criteria are binary and conjunctive with several legs each, so a near-miss on one leg of a 2.0-weight criterion costs 3.4% of functional; with 43 criteria the granularity is still fine. 3. Visual is the only likert dimension (3 criteria, 20% of reward); the earlier Oracle run shows it does produce non-extreme values (0.9167).
